notes.title: New Character Voices
notes.content:
[h1]New Voices in Hobo Cat Adventures[/h1]

I'm happy to announce that talented actress and voice talent [b]Sabrina Meier[/b] lent her voice to bring a total of three female characters to life. 

Following characters received a voice-over in this update:

Laura Bunny - [spoiler]Sister/Wife of Butts Bunny[/spoiler]
Petunia - [spoiler]Penguin in the Snowy Mountains Area[/spoiler]
Penny Punyama - [spoiler]Mother of Penus[/spoiler]

Thank you very much Sabrina, I had a blast working with you!
Follow Sabrina here:
https://www.instagram.com/jayfeather_x/
https://twitter.com/Sabrina21944132

To celebrate [b]Hobo Cat Adventures is currently 50% off[/b] for a whole week!

notes.title: Hobo Cat Presents Motördoom
notes.content:
[h1]Motördoom[/h1]

I'm happy to announce my second game I'm working on: [b]Motördoom[/b]
Motördoom is a freestyle-sports-shooter that combines high octane, visceral combat with fluid movement and trick mechanics. Perform gnarly tricks while defeating grotesque monsters and upgrade your character with demonic offerings to become ever more powerful.

Basically THPS meets Vampire Survivors!

notes.title: Linux Support Broadcast
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Hobo Cat Adventures is now available for Linux 🐧
To celebrate the game is currently 40% off. Thanks to everyone who played it so far!
Next to making it available on Linux here are all the changes and bug fixes that are included in the update.

Updates

- Linux Build. You can now play Hobo Cat Adventures on your Linux machine
- Balanced enemy health and weapon damage / stamina usage to make the different weapons more useful
- Implemented Unitys new Input System. The game should now work with most controllers without changing any Steam settings
- Pressing buttons in the pause menu won't trigger any of Hobo Cats movements anymore
- Camera sensitivity settings are now similar for mouse and controller
- Plugin out the controller causes the game to pause
- Outro cutscene can now be skipped
- Windows IL2CPP Build for better performance

Fixed Bugs

- Qutting during the race caused a bug where you couldn't interact with the bear anymore
- Coin particles didn't show up when killing enemies / destroying barrels
- Death cam didn't use the cam settings
- Rain didn't show up in the last section of the game

Cheers,

Chris
Hobo Cat Games

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]
2021 is over! And what a year it was. I just wanted to reach out to you and say a huge THANK YOU! Thank you for playing my game and with that supporting me in doing what I love to do. Hobo Cat Adventures marked my first commercial released game ever and I'm very thankful for all the people who played the game on steam. Especially thanks to all the people who left a review, posted screenshots, made play-through videos, engaged in conversations or reached out to me over on discord. You are awesome!
It was such a pleasure experiencing all that stuff and I met some wonderful people because of it. It was all of you who made 2021 a great year for me. Thanks!

With that I wish you all the best, have fun with your friends and families, enjoy your night and I will see you in 2022! Cheers!

Chris
Hobo Cat Games

notes.title: DEMO coming to steam game festival
notes.content:
Play a short demo of Hobo Cat Adventures during the steam games festival! The demo will only be available during the festival so make sure to play it while it's hot! 
The steam game festival lasts from February 3 up until February 9, 2021. 

[b]The Demo[/b]
In the demo you will be able to play the tutorial level of Hobo Cat Adventures. Explore the [b]Carrot Fields[/b] where you will meet "Butts" the carrot farmer, "Scary" the scarecrow and some other fun characters. 

[b]Steam Game Festival[/b]
During the festival there will be [b]two live streams[/b]. 
[list]
[*] First on Friday, February 5. The Swiss stream-team "Geek Stübli" will check out Hobo Cat Adventures. This stream will be in Swiss-German and will also be streamed to twitch.
[*] Second on Saturday, February 6. This is the developer stream. You'll be able to watch the dev play, ask questions, give feedback and have general chit-chat.
[/list]

Join the Hobo Cat [b]Discord Server[/b] to give feedback on the game, make feature suggestions and meet other cool Hobo Cats!

🎮https://discord.gg/Dem44hRY
